name: Jekamam
title: Levite of the family of Hebron
summary: Jekamam was a Levite belonging to the family of Hebron, a subgroup of the Kohathites. He is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as the fourth son of Hebron. His role was connected to Levitical service in the temple during King David's organization of worship.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as a son of Hebron
keyEvents.description: Jekamam is recorded as the fourth son of Hebron in the genealogy of the Levites.

keyEvents.title: Organization of the Levites under David
keyEvents.description: King David organized the Levites according to their families for service in the house of the Lord, and Jekamam was counted among the descendants of Hebron.

keyEvents.title: Confirmed in the Hebronite line
keyEvents.description: Jekamam is mentioned again as the fourth in the Hebronite line in a repeated overview of the Levitical families.

keyEvents.title: The Levites' Service Assignments
keyEvents.description: As part of the Kohathite branch, Jekamam's clan was assigned specific tasks related to sanctuary service.
